description: Context-aware delegation and microtasking model. Policy only — Firstmate remains authority for spawn, approval, and quota-array-dispatch.

firstmateExisting: AGENTS.md hard rules and section 7 lifecycle
firstmateExtensionRequired: structured evidence chain enforcement between workers
delegation gate before primary tool use on project paths

delegationFirstRule.summary: For every incoming task, ask first: can a worker do this? If yes, delegate immediately — do not analyze, plan, or implement first.
forbiddenAsDefaultFirstmateWork: project tests or documentation by firstmate
manual project file edits except hard rule 1 captain-approved exception
explicitExceptions: hard rule 1 concrete captain-approved project operation
shared tracked material when fleet is empty

levels.label: Very low
levels.description: Nearly local: syntax, symbol lookup, pattern check, isolated SQL explanation.
levels.routingHint: Prefer cheap profiles when crew-knowledge agrees; still use fm-spawn flags, not a parallel router.

levels.label: Low
levels.description: Few connected artifacts: one module, one API function, bounded test surface.
levels.routingHint: Microtask with context pack; DIRECT DELEGATION if scope is already one bounded unit.

levels.label: Medium
levels.description: Several components or architectural context required.
levels.routingHint: MICROTASK + CONTEXT PACK or single FULL-CONTEXT worker.

levels.label: High
levels.description: System-wide concerns: data flow, auth, state, queues, API contracts, migrations, cross-service.
levels.routingHint: FULL-CONTEXT DELEGATION or SCOUT then SHIP.

levels.label: Very high
levels.description: Central architecture, complex migrations, security models, many implicit dependencies.
levels.typicalWorkerContext: full-context agent or scout report first
levels.routingHint: SCOUT → SHIP or one FULL-CONTEXT DELEGATION.

executionModes.label: Direct delegation
executionModes.when: Task is already one bounded unit with sufficient context in the brief.
executionModes.shipScoutRelation: Ship or Scout deliverable type is chosen separately at intake; this mode is how work is handed off.

executionModes.label: Microtask
executionModes.when: VERY_LOW or LOW context dependency and worker can succeed with minimal context pack.
executionModes.shipScoutRelation: Usually Ship sub-units; Scout only for read-only slices.

executionModes.label: Microtask + context pack
executionModes.when: MEDIUM dependency; each slice has explicit TASK, GOAL, files, symbols, constraints, expected output.
executionModes.shipScoutRelation: Ship parallel or serial microtasks with shared pack appendix.

executionModes.label: Full-context delegation
executionModes.when: HIGH or VERY_HIGH dependency, or microtask benefit negative after verification cost.
executionModes.shipScoutRelation: Single Ship worker or Scout with broad read scope.

executionModes.label: Scout → Ship
executionModes.when: Uncertainty could change whether or what to build; investigation deliverable before implementation.
executionModes.shipScoutRelation: Firstmate intake Ship/Scout classification (AGENTS.md §7); promotion via fm-promote.sh.

antiPatterns: smaller task always cheaper or better
firstmate evaluates every trivial slice personally

compressionVsLoss.compressionAllowed: Reduce 100 files to 5 relevant files plus architecture rules and API contracts.
compressionVsLoss.lossForbidden: Cut to 2 files when the decision depends on global state, invariants, or cross-cutting contracts.

evidenceChain.noBlindSynthesis: Conflicting worker or scout results require more evidence or a larger-context task — never average or guess.

progressiveContextExpansion: If worker blocked or answers contradict, expand targeted files or invariants
Escalate to full-context worker or scout before repeated micro-failures

preferSingleTaskWhen: verification cost of many slices exceeds one integrated pass
shared mutable state or ordering constraints
preferMicrotaskWhen: VERY_LOW or LOW dependency with clear boundaries
independent files with separate test surfaces
high parallelizability with low merge conflict risk
